title: Teashop waiters, restrooms and festival fireworks
my: လက်ဖက်ရည်ဆိုင်၊ အိမ်သာနဲ့ မီးပန်းပွဲ
notes: Sit at the teashop, read the menu, chat with the waiter and order. Your tea and snacks arrive at your table.
Talk with every food seller on Food Street and at the pwe stalls, and buy from their menus.
Stalls have price boards in Myanmar, gas bottles and strings of bulbs.
The crowd talks about what is around them: the food, the rides, the stage and the pagoda.
Public restrooms (🚻) near the corners of the fair, on the map too.
Queues at the big wheel, the pirate ship and the bumper cars, and crowds watching the hand-turned wheel and the carousel.
Bumper cars: you sit in your own car with a camera behind you (C or the button switches to first person). Empty cars wait by the gate, and the cars no longer chase you when you just walk in.
More fireworks for Thadingyut and Tazaungdaing: lotus, star and golden rain shells, salvos across the lake, longer little shows and a longer finale.
Runs smoother on small and older phones: lighter graphics to start, and it steps down by itself if the fair starts to lag.
Version history and patch notes, here in the game.

title: Phones sideways and better maps
my: ဖုန်းကို အလျားလိုက်ကစားရန်နဲ့ မြေပုံအသစ်
notes: Play with your phone sideways, with a compact layout and a turn-your-phone hint.
A sharp mini map sized to your screen.
A full map you can drag and zoom, with a Me button and a legend.

title: Live players fixed and update alerts
my: ကစားသူများ အချိန်နဲ့တပြေးညီ ပြင်ဆင်ချက်
notes: Players on other devices now show up in the fair in real time.
The game tells you when a new version is ready, with a Refresh button.

title: Pwe rides, the mini train and day and night
notes: Burmese pwe rides: the hand-turned wheel and the flying swing.
A mini train that runs its loop around the fair.
Drive your own bumper car.
Morning, afternoon, evening and night, with a time picker and live Yangon time.
A new HUD with your pwe ticket and tonight's journey.

title: Wishing Lake, teashop and candle festival
my: ဆုတောင်းကန်၊ လက်ဖက်ရည်ဆိုင်နဲ့ မီးထွန်းပွဲ
notes: The crowd speaks Myanmar, and there is a big Wishing Lake with lanterns and candles.
First-person views on the rides.
A public fair where everyone online meets, Myanmar dance and music, the candle festival and the teashop.

title: The fair in 3D and Thadingyut wishes
notes: The whole fair rebuilt in 3D, with chat in Myanmar.
Thadingyut wishes saved for everyone to see.
Smoother walking and the KhitHaung font.

title: The first night
notes: Yay Kyaw Nights opens: Myanmar avatars, friend rooms and the fair map.
